column2: `read_main_health()` still needs to inspect the raw `commandresult` from `gh.run_list_filtered_read()` before any `shiperror` conversion, because the current `run_list_filtered()` path drops stderr/stdout and makes the missing-workflow signature impossible to classify. without that refactor, repos that lack the configured `ci` workflow will still surface `main_ci_status=error` instead of `skip`.
`_premerge_main_health_gate()` needs an explicit `skip` terminal branch; otherwise the new status falls through to the stalled path.
`_postmerge_main_health_gate()` likewise needs to treat `skip` as terminal, or post-merge runs will stall on the default-branch ci health detail.
